FINALITY UNCHECKED: no example in payload version v3 carries a `status`, so whether any of the 2 figure(s) below is the FINAL collected penalty or a notice figure since reduced, set aside or never collected could not be looked at. From major 4 every example carries `status`, `final_as_of` and `litigation` (eco-system ticket 79 item 1). A named could-not-look. FREQUENCY UNSOURCED: this line annualises at (1, 2, 4) events/yr, which is this converter's editorial default and not a counted rate. Payload version v3 predates the publisher's `frequency` field, so no basis and no denominator could be read for it; from major 4 the basis belongs on regimes.uk-gdpr.violation_types.lower-tier.frequency.basis.
